identity.title: Certificate of Annual Maintenance — Portable Fire Extinguishers

scan.summary: This is a supplier's certificate from a qualified fire extinguisher service company documenting that all 14 portable fire extinguishers at the Portland facility were inspected and maintained on August 20, 2025, in accordance with NFPA 10 (2022), Chapter 7. The service included examination, weighing, pressure verification, hose and nozzle checks, tamper seal replacement, and service tag attachment. All units passed inspection.
scan.freshness_note: This certificate is from August 2025 and is 13 months old as of September 29, 2026. Annual maintenance was due August 20, 2026, and is now overdue. A current certificate should be obtained immediately.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on all factual readings—the document is clear and well-structured. The service was performed by a properly licensed technician using current standards. The only gap is that this is a supplier's document and thus is not judged for compliance; the company's responsibility is to ensure current annual maintenance is obtained before August 21, 2026, and to conduct and record monthly visual inspections. The certificate is now overdue for renewal (13 months past the August 20, 2026 deadline as of the current date September 29, 2026). Unit L-1 may have a hydrostatic testing concern—the certificate shows last test in 2020 with next due in 2025, but the certificate is dated August 2025, creating ambiguity about whether that test was completed.
